note: City of Hutchinson (PRCE) campground in Masonic/West River Park beside the Crow River, behind the Days Inn off Highway 7; boat landing and dock, paddle-sport rentals, wildlife sanctuary and the Luce Line Trail. No seasonal camping. --Claude
